title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Tecla de falar. Keep it, take the intercom, take the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Tecla de falar
options.lineage: The one-column handset: a center talk key and two soft keys
options.thesis: The day is one measured column worked with one thumb, and nothing is saved until a soft key says sim.
options.viewport: Portrait. A named phase band, seven timed rows, and a three-key deck flush to the bottom, the center key reading Segurar.
options.risk: Turns into a Nokia costume if a handset is drawn around the list, or if Segurar becomes a floating round mic.

raised.raise: Recording and confirm take the whole glass; the list recedes until you are done.
No handset in the margin. State is an instant full-region invert.
At rest the list stays quiet. Color lives in the phase band and the talk key.
Every phase is written: Pronto, Gravando, Ouvindo, Confirmar, Sem microfone.
Time sits in a fixed gutter. The screen never draws the audio.
Confirm uses the same keys as the list, and discard returns to the same row.

options.label: Interfone
options.lineage: The apartment intercom and the porteiro’s log
options.thesis: You hold the lobby button, and the line is not filed until you confirm it in the book.
options.viewport: Portrait. The day’s ruled lines fill the top; a metal plate holds one hold-button and two engraved keys.
options.risk: The round lobby button is where most hold-to-speak products already land.

options.label: Memórias no escuro
options.lineage: A console memory room: towers drifting in fog
options.thesis: Each record is a glowing object you glide toward in a dark room.
options.viewport: A void with a few amber records floating at camera depth.
options.risk: The day cannot be scanned, and the hold-to-talk ritual has nowhere to sit.
options.case: Loses both: a memory palace is not the phone-in-hand scene, and spatial glide hides confirm and the list.
options.kept: The active step owns the whole glass.

options.label: Painel de cotovelos
options.lineage: A starship wall of pastel pills on black
options.thesis: Categories are color banks, and every region is a button with a code.
options.viewport: Black glass split into lilac, peach, and gold pills labeled with codes.
options.risk: Numeric clusters replace Portuguese sentences, and a tap grammar fights press-and-hold.
options.case: Loses both: the life task is not a starship board, and codes cannot carry a title, a time, and a confirm.
options.kept: The interface is the frame, and state flips instantly.

options.label: Borda de nuvem
options.lineage: An iridescent cloud edge studied as evidence
options.thesis: The day is a white field with color only in a spectral fringe.
options.viewport: Wide margins, a quiet text field, and a mint-rose-violet edge.
options.risk: The topology is an explainer of droplet physics, not a capture flow.
options.case: Loses both: nobody recognizes a secretary here, and the sections are scientific samples rather than records.
options.kept: At rest, color stays in a band and the field stays quiet.

options.label: Ciclorama
options.lineage: A theater cyclorama washing from night to day
options.thesis: The day is a lighting cue, scrubbed from black through cobalt and rose to white.
options.viewport: Stacked atmosphere bands with stencil cue names and no list of errands.
options.risk: Time-of-day color pretends to be the product, which stores records, not a sunrise.
options.case: Loses both: a light plot is not how this day is kept, and a cue timeline cannot hold appointments and tasks.
options.kept: Phases are named in words, so color is never the only signal.

options.label: Osciloscópio
options.lineage: A bench oscilloscope with a phosphor trace
options.thesis: Speech is a green trace you freeze on a graticule before it becomes a record.
options.viewport: One square screen, a locked waveform, and knobs for scale and trigger.
options.risk: The trace is the voice-memo waveform this product refuses, and audio is not the memory.
options.case: Loses both: the street errand is not a signal bench, and knobs plus a waveform hide the confirm card.
options.kept: A fixed time gutter that measures every row, and no picture of the sound.

options.label: HyperCard
options.lineage: A shoebox stack of black-and-white cards
options.thesis: Each utterance is a card you flip, edit, and link, with paint tools one menu away.
options.viewport: One card at a time, a painted border, and buttons that flip the stack.
options.risk: A stack hides the day: fifteen cards cannot be scanned, and in-place editing skips the confirm.
options.case: Loses both: HyperCard is not the object he reaches for between things, and one-card navigation fails a working-day list.
options.kept: Confirm is the same kind of object as the list, and back returns to the same place.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A round talk button and a plain list of today’s items, set as carefully as a good product screen.
canonCard.viewport: Portrait. The word Rafael, a large circular Segurar control, then the day’s rows underneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other voice inboxes, by design.
